mechanism_narrative: The continued recovery in WORKPLACES mobility over the last three weeks indicates more weekday commuting. That should raise retail-and-recreation visits within four weeks because shoppers add errands around trips to work and city-centre footfall improves.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES remains near its current level or rises further but RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is not higher than over the last 28 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in RESIDENTIAL time reflects more time spent at home and fewer discretionary trips. If that home-staying intensity continues, RETAIL_REC should fall over the next one to two weeks because fewer short local shopping and leisure outings are made.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL stays above its pre-period baseline by at least 15 points for two consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL remains elevated by at least 15 points for two weeks and RETAIL_REC does not decline relative to the prior four weeks within 7 to 14 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS mobility rebounds after a temporary dip while TRANSIT remains depressed, outdoor leisure substitutes for indoor retail and recreation. Under that mixed pattern, retail mobility should soften over the next four weeks because discretionary trips are diverted away from shopping venues.
candidate_trigger: PARKS rises by more than 10 points from the prior week while TRANSIT stays below -50
failure_condition: If PARKS rises above its recent level while TRANSIT remains below -50 but RETAIL_REC is not lower over the next 28 days than over the previous 28 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT remains severely suppressed, access costs to central shopping and leisure districts stay high. That should keep RETAIL_REC below its recent average over the next four weeks because fewer trips are made for nonessential retail.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -55 for at least three consecutive weekly means
failure_condition: If TRANSIT stays below -55 for three weeks but RETAIL_REC does not move lower than its last-four-week mean in the subsequent month, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A narrowing gap between GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC implies households are reallocating trips from essentials toward discretionary purchases as confidence normalizes. That rebalancing should lift RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
candidate_trigger: the difference between GROCERY_PHARM and RETAIL_REC shrinks by at least 20 points from one week to the next
failure_condition: If the GROCERY_PHARM minus RETAIL_REC gap narrows by at least 20 points but RETAIL_REC does not rise within two weeks, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained summer-type lift in PARKS mobility should not translate into more retail-and-recreation visits when it is driven by outdoor substitution rather than broad demand recovery. In that case, RETAIL_REC is likely to stay flat or weaken over the next month.
failure_condition: If PARKS remains elevated or rebounds further and RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days relative to the prior 28 days, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: An uptick in WORKPLACES combined with a parallel recovery in TRANSIT indicates that commuting frictions are easing. Once both series improve together, retail-and-recreation mobility should rise within four weeks because the same trips can support shopping and leisure stops.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES rises for two consecutive weeks and TRANSIT improves by at least 5 points over the same period
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both improve for two weeks but RETAIL_REC is not higher in the following month than in the previous month, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening-restrictions regime, a further drop in TRANSIT after an already weak baseline should immediately suppress discretionary trips. RETAIL_REC should fall over the next one to two weeks because central shopping and leisure access deteriorates faster than household routines adjust.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls by more than 5 points week-on-week while already below -55
failure_condition: If TRANSIT drops further from an already sub -55 level but RETAIL_REC does not decline within 7 to 14 days, the hypothesis fails.
